The plate is a square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across (about 460 px in the image). The rice pile spans about 200 px, or roughly 11 cm, and about 150 px, or roughly 8 cm, in the other direction. It looks about 2 cm thick at most.

Cooked brown rice weighs roughly 0.15 g per cm³ of loose volume... more precisely, it packs at about 0.6-0.7 g/cm³. The pile covers about 11 × 8 × 0.7 (an elliptical footprint) ≈ 70 cm² of area, and at about 1.5 cm average height that gives roughly 100 cm³. At about 0.65 g/cm³ that is about 65 g, though the pile may be a little larger, so I'll estimate about 110 g.

Cooked brown rice has about 1.1-1.2 kcal/g, so 110 g comes to roughly 125 kcal. There are small bits of carrot and possibly some oil, so I'll round up to about 140 kcal.
